questions.stemHtml: A 33-year-old female is suffering from Diarrhoea. She was on 3rd generation cephalosporin a few weeks ago. CT scan of the abdomen is given. What is the drug of choice for this condition?
questions.solutionHtml:
Oral Vancomycin

Oral Vancomycin is an antibiotic used in the treatment of severe bacterial infections in hospitalized patients. It is effective against infections of the respiratory tract (e.g. pneumonia), urinary tract, skin and soft tissues, bones and joints, heart, blood, and others.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 809

questions.stem: A 37-year-old man has a fever, malaise, headache, and severe abdominal pain. Rebound tenderness is present. Diagnosis of peritonitis is made and the patient is shifted to the operation theatre. After the surgery, he was shifted to the surgery ward. There he acquired an MRSA infection. What is the drug of choice for a given infection ?
questions.solutionHtml:
Vancomycin

Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 809

questions.stem: Burkholderia cepacia is intrinsically resistant to:
questions.solutionHtml:
Polymyxin B

Polymyxin B  is an antibiotic used to treat meningitis, pneumonia, sepsis, and urinary tract infections. While it is useful for many Gram-negative infections, it is not useful for Gram-positive infections. It can be given by injection into a vein, muscle, or cerebrospinal fluid.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 809

questions.stem: Following drugs inhibit bacterial protein synthesis except:
questions.solutionHtml:
Daptomycin

Lipopeptides (daptomycin) are bactericidal by causing depolarization of bacterial cell membranes with K+ efflux and rapid cell death.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 808
